tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Documentation
tools.description:
Search Better Auth documentation and return matching snippets.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Find setup guides for authentication providers (email, OAuth, passkeys)
- Look up plugin configuration (two-factor, admin, organization)
- Find API references for client or server methods
- Troubleshoot errors or configuration issues

<examples>
- "session management" → finds docs about session handling, expiration, refresh
- "two-factor" → finds two-factor authentication plugin setup
- "nextjs middleware" → finds Next.js integration guides
Bad queries: avoid single generic words like 'auth' or 'config' — be specific.
</examples>

<hints>
- Returns snippets only. Use get_doc(path) to read the full page content.
- Results are grouped by page — one result per documentation page.
- IMPORTANT: Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question.
</hints>

query.description: Search query. Can be a concept, plugin name, API method, or error message.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

tools.name: get_doc
tools.title: Get Document
tools.description:
Get Better Auth documentation content. Returns the documentation index (llms.txt) if no path is provided, or the full page content for a specific path.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Browse all available documentation pages (call without path)
- Read the complete guide for a specific topic found via search_docs
- Get code examples and configuration details for a feature

<examples>
get_doc() → returns full documentation index
get_doc(path="/docs/concepts/session-management") → full session management guide
get_doc(path="/docs/plugins/2fa") → two-factor authentication plugin docs
</examples>

<hints>
- Call without path to see all available pages before diving into a specific one.
- Always use search_docs first to find the correct path — do not guess documentation paths.
- Anchors (e.g. #section-id) are accepted but the full page is returned.
</hints>

path.description: Documentation page path (e.g. /docs/concepts/session-management). Omit to get the full documentation index.
